items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: He liked the way we played. He said he got a job at the Onyx Club, and he'd like to use all three of us.

ctx.x: Well, when I come back to New York, I got my own trio at the Victoria Cafe, at 141st Street and Seventh Avenue. Pete Brown, Don Frye and myself. I guess I was there around four or five years...say about four years altogether...three years...almost four years. And when I left there, I got an offer to go down to the Brickwood Cafe with the same band. That's at 146th and Lenox Avenue. I was there about two years.
And then John Kirby came in one night, brought his bass down, and he wanted... He liked the way we played. He said he got a job at the Onyx Club, and he'd like to use all three of us.
So you were at the Onyx Club.
